source_commit_subject: fix(ci): restore Rust gates and record UDP fault coverage
source_scope: 19 selected production, ABI, test and build inputs match Linux byte-for-byte; not a hermetic whole-worktree release manifest.

execution.runtime: native root host CLI; two private MTU-1500 network namespaces, selected cgroup, persistent connected dual-stack sockets

findings.before: Both modes exited 0 and claimed complete capture. GSO-only exported two fictitious aggregate datagrams; GSO+GRO exported four. Full IP lengths 3117/3137 represented multiple native datagrams rather than a valid single observed UDP datagram.
findings.fix: Check gso_size or gso_segs > 1 after selected-port filtering and before normal datagram length validation/admission. Reject aggregates as unsupported; existing capture accounting marks incomplete and exits 3. Original traffic is always allowed.
findings.interpretation: This fixes false evidence and false completeness; it does not normalize GSO/GRO into per-datagram facts. Unsupported counts are aggregate hook observations, not missing wire-packet counts.
development_attempts: before-false and before-true: expected failing reproductions with the old product
after-false and after-true: first repaired passes, excluded from final repeats
regressions: mtu-regression: real unfragmented and fragmented IPv4/IPv6 passed
pressure-regression: application truncation and receive-queue drops passed
lifecycle-regression: real collector overflow and fault recovery passed
findings.raw_evidence: Each directory retains native worker oracles, diagnostic.json and actual export.json. Compact expected_sha256 values bind exact accepted per-peer packet multisets.
